observations.content:
Summary: Jensen Huang is the co-founder, president, and CEO of Nvidia, the world's most valuable company. He founded the company in 1993 and has served as its president, chief executive officer, and a member of the board of directors since then. As of September 2026, Forbes estimates his net worth at over US$190 billion, making him the eighth-wealthiest individual in the world. Huang holds a BSEE degree from Oregon State University and an MSEE degree from Stanford University.
